variables.name: accent
variables.description: ACCENT BUDGET: accent and accent-2 together cover only roughly 10–15% of any canvas.

variables.name: neutral-light/1300
variables.description: Darkest neutral. Default heading colour (Light) and secondary background (Dark).

variables.name: accent-2
variables.description: Second accent (#B4FF6B), for highlighted text on brand-blue surfaces (4.83:1 on brand/500). ACCENT BUDGET: accent and accent-2 together cover only roughly 10–15% of any canvas. Added 2026-10-16; the existing accent (#68DD68) is unchanged.

variables.name: background/primary
variables.description: DEFAULT canvas background. Apply to every page/screen root. No border. Override only when a specific colour is requested.

variables.name: background/secondary
variables.description: Alternate canvas for banded/striped sections. No border. Dark: neutral-light/1300 (#0C1927).

variables.name: background/tertiary
variables.description: Deepest canvas tone. Section wells and recessed page areas.

variables.name: background/inverse
variables.description: Inverted canvas — dark band in Light theme. Pair with text/inverse.

variables.name: background/brand
variables.description: Brand-filled canvas region: hero, CTA band. Pair with text/on-brand.

variables.name: background/brand-subtle
variables.description: Tinted brand canvas for informational bands.

variables.name: background/success-subtle
variables.description: Success banner / confirmation band. Pair with text/success.

variables.name: background/error-subtle
variables.description: Error banner band. Pair with text/error.

variables.name: container/primary
variables.description: DEFAULT container background — cards, panels, sheets. Light: neutral-light/100, paired with a border/container border by default.

variables.name: container/secondary
variables.description: Container nested inside a container/primary.

variables.name: container/tertiary
variables.description: Third-level nesting, inset wells, code blocks.

variables.name: container/selected
variables.description: Selected / active state for rows, tabs, nav items.

variables.name: container/brand
variables.description: Brand-filled container. Pair with text/on-brand.

variables.name: container/success
variables.description: DEFAULT success container — green/100 in Light. 1px border/success border. Pair with text/success.

variables.name: container/error
variables.description: DEFAULT error container — red/100 in Light. 1px border/error border. Pair with text/error.

variables.name: container/inverse
variables.description: Inverted container. Pair with text/inverse.

variables.name: text/primary
variables.description: LEGACY ALIAS — intentionally resolves to the same value as text/body. Kept so existing work keeps resolving; prefer text/body in new work, which states intent.

variables.name: text/secondary
variables.description: Supporting copy, descriptions, secondary labels. Light: neutral-light/900 (#40566D).

variables.name: text/tertiary
variables.description: Muted text: timestamps, captions, helper text. Light: neutral-light/600 (#768EA7). Contrast is 3.4:1 on background/primary, so use it for large or non-essential text only.

variables.name: text/placeholder
variables.description: Input placeholder text ONLY — never for real content. Meets AA on container/primary.

variables.name: text/inverse
variables.description: Text on background/inverse or container/inverse.

variables.name: text/brand
variables.description: Brand-coloured text and emphasis.

variables.name: text/link
variables.description: Hyperlinks in body copy. Currently shares a value with text/eyebrow and border/focus by coincidence, not by design — these are kept SEPARATE so they can diverge later.

variables.name: text/success
variables.description: Success messaging. Tuned so Light and Dark land on the same contrast (5.69 on container/success in both) — neither theme is the weaker one.

variables.name: text/error
variables.description: Error messaging and validation. 4.50:1 on error-subtle — passes AA with no headroom.

variables.name: text/on-brand
variables.description: Text on any brand-filled surface (background/brand, container/brand, primary button).

variables.name: border/primary
variables.description: OPT-IN only. Default containers already carry a 1px border/container edge; use border/primary instead when a stronger border is needed: inputs, table dividers, or when a request explicitly calls for one.

variables.name: border/secondary
variables.description: Subtle dividers and separators.

variables.name: border/strong
variables.description: High-emphasis border for inputs needing definition.

variables.name: border/brand
variables.description: Brand-emphasised border, selected cards.

variables.name: border/focus
variables.description: Keyboard focus ring. Shares a value with text/link and text/eyebrow today but is kept separate so it can diverge. Never remove focus without an equivalent indicator.

variables.name: border/success
variables.description: Valid input border.

variables.name: border/error
variables.description: Invalid input border. Never the sole error signal — pair with text/error.

variables.name: border/inverse
variables.description: Border on inverted surfaces.

variables.name: container/elevated
variables.description: Surface that reads as RAISED — modals and popovers only. ELEVATION IS CARRIED BY THE SHADOW, which is identical in Light and Dark (Elevation/Low Raised, Elevation/Mid Raised have no theme variants). The fill only assists. In Dark it shares a value with container/tertiary; that is acceptable because the shadow, not the tone, does the lifting.

variables.name: text/heading
variables.description: DEFAULT for all headings (h1–h6). Light: neutral-light/1300 (#0C1927). Dark: neutral-light/100 (#F1F5FA). Do not use for body copy.

variables.name: text/body
variables.description: DEFAULT for all body copy and paragraph text. Light: neutral-light/1100 (#243547). Dark: neutral-light/300 (#CBD5E2).

variables.name: text/eyebrow
variables.description: Eyebrow / kicker / overline. brand/500 Light, brand/300 Dark. 10px, Medium (Semi Bold permitted), ALL CAPS — so ALWAYS small text: 4.5:1 required, the 3:1 large-text exemption never applies. PLACEMENT: only on background/primary, container/primary, background/brand-subtle or container/selected. Fails on container/secondary (4.38) and container/tertiary (3.58). Shares a value with text/link and border/focus today but is a separate token so it can diverge.

variables.name: border/container
variables.description: DEFAULT border for container/primary. Light: neutral-light/200. Very low contrast by design — see the ratios in semantic.css.

variables.name: background/accent
variables.description: Accent fill for a highlight moment — a callout band, a stat, a graphic block. Pair with text/on-accent. ACCENT BUDGET: roughly 10-15% of any asset, counting fills and accent text together.

variables.name: container/accent
variables.description: Accent-filled container. Pair with text/on-accent.  ACCENT BUDGET: accent is a highlight, not a palette. Keep it to roughly 10-15% of any asset — enough that the design does not read as flat, never so much that it competes with brand blue.

variables.name: text/on-accent
variables.description: Text on any accent-filled surface. Accent is a bright lime, so text on it must be near-black — white fails badly.  ACCENT BUDGET: accent is a highlight, not a palette. Keep it to roughly 10-15% of any asset — enough that the design does not read as flat, never so much that it competes with brand blue.

variables.name: border/accent
variables.description: Accent border for a highlighted edge.  ACCENT BUDGET: accent is a highlight, not a palette. Keep it to roughly 10-15% of any asset — enough that the design does not read as flat, never so much that it competes with brand blue.

variables.name: text/accent
variables.description: Accent AS TEXT. Permitted ONLY on a dark ground — verify 4.5:1 before using. LIGHT theme: background/inverse and container/inverse only (8.64). It FAILS on every light surface: background/primary 1.73, container/primary 1.58, container/tertiary 1.17. DARK theme: passes on all standard dark surfaces (7.43-9.57) but FAILS on background/inverse and container/inverse (1.69, they are light in Dark) and on brand fills (3.07). Counts toward the 10-15% accent budget. Default remains text/on-accent for text sitting ON an accent fill; this token is for accent text sitting on something else.

variables.name: container/info
variables.description: Added 2026-10-14 at the brand team's request for Badge intents (Information, Intense Positive/Negative).

variables.name: text/info
variables.description: Added 2026-10-14 at the brand team's request for Badge intents (Information, Intense Positive/Negative). Use for text on Information badges and notes.

variables.name: container/info-strong
variables.description: Added 2026-10-14 at the brand team's request for Badge intents (Information, Intense Positive/Negative).

variables.name: container/success-strong
variables.description: Added 2026-10-14 at the brand team's request for Badge intents (Information, Intense Positive/Negative).

variables.name: container/error-strong
variables.description: Added 2026-10-14 at the brand team's request for Badge intents (Information, Intense Positive/Negative).

variables.name: text/on-strong
variables.description: Added 2026-10-14 at the brand team's request for Badge intents (Information, Intense Positive/Negative).

variables.name: text/accent-on-brand
variables.description: Highlighted text (a key phrase) on background/brand or container/brand only, e.g. the last item of a proof strip on a page breaker. 4.83:1 on brand/500. Never on light or dark surfaces: there use text/link (light) or text/accent (dark). Counts toward the 10–15% accent budget.
